name: Shikanoin Heizou
notes: A 4-star Anemo driver. Heartstopper Strike (227.5% ATK at level 1) carries his damage, so the damage talent is the Skill; both sources put it first, with the Normal Attack next (KQM: Skill, Normal Attack, Burst for the on-field driver; Skill, Burst, Normal Attack as a quickswap support). His scaling is ATK in the card, from his ATK-based CRIT build (Game8: Anemo CRIT DPS; KQM: the ADC build); his EM or Swirl build is the other option and is listed after it. Both sources agree on 4pc Viridescent Venerer as by far the best set; Lavawalker and Thundersoother are KQM's for personal damage. The mains differ: the CRIT builds use ATK% (or ER) on the Sands, an Anemo DMG Goblet and a CRIT Circlet; the EM builds use EM on every slot. The weapons differ: Game8's best for the CRIT build is Tulaytullah's Remembrance, KQM's list starts with Skyward Atlas; A Thousand Floating Dreams is Game8's best for the EM build. Neither source gives stat goals. The only goal is ER, KQM's 120-130% with two Skill uses at C0-C3 (200% or more with one Skill use; 100% at C4+).
